title: Blessings and Curses

questions.question: If you obey the voice of the Lord, where will you be blessed?
options: In the city and in the field
questions.correctAnswer: In the city and in the field
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:3 (ESV): "Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field."

questions.question: What will happen to enemies who rise against you if you obey?
options: They shall be defeated and flee in seven ways
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be defeated and flee in seven ways
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:7 (ESV): "The Lord will cause your enemies... to be defeated... they shall come out... one way and flee before you seven ways."

questions.question: If you disobey, what will happen in the city and field?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:16 (ESV): "Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field."

questions.question: The Lord will make you the head and not the what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:13 (ESV): "And the Lord will make you the head and not the tail..."

questions.question: With what will the Lord strike the disobeyer regarding the mind?
options: Madness, blindness, and confusion of mind
questions.correctAnswer: Madness, blindness, and confusion of mind
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:28 (ESV): "The Lord will strike you with madness and blindness and confusion of mind."

questions.question: The Lord will establish you as what kind of people?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:9 (ESV): "The Lord will establish you as a people holy to himself..."

questions.question: What climatic curse is mentioned?
options: The heavens shall be bronze and the earth iron
questions.correctAnswer: The heavens shall be bronze and the earth iron
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:23 (ESV): "And the heavens over your head shall be bronze, and the earth under you shall be iron."

questions.question: Because you did not serve the Lord with joyfulness, who will you serve?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:47–48 (ESV): "Because you did not serve the Lord your God with joyfulness... therefore you shall serve your enemies..."

questions.question: What nation will the Lord bring against them from far away?
options: A nation whose language you do not understand, swift as the eagle
questions.correctAnswer: A nation whose language you do not understand, swift as the eagle
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:49 (ESV): "The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away... swift as the eagle flies, a nation whose language you do not understand..."

questions.question: What severe hunger will happen during the siege?
options: They will eat the fruit of their womb (their children)
questions.correctAnswer: They will eat the fruit of their womb (their children)
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:53 (ESV): "And you shall eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your sons and daughters..."

questions.question: To where will the Lord bring you back in ships?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:68 (ESV): "And the Lord will bring you back in ships to Egypt..."

questions.question: What disease of Egypt will cling to them?
options: The boils of Egypt, tumors, scabs, and itch
questions.correctAnswer: The boils of Egypt, tumors, scabs, and itch
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:27 (ESV): "The Lord will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with tumors and scabs and itch..."

questions.question: Your life shall hang in doubt before you; you shall fear when?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:66 (ESV): "Your life shall hang in doubt before you. Night and day you shall be in dread..."

questions.question: What will happen to the sojourner who is among you?
options: He shall mount up higher and higher, and you shall come down lower and lower
questions.correctAnswer: He shall mount up higher and higher, and you shall come down lower and lower
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:43 (ESV): "The sojourner who is among you shall rise higher and higher above you, and you shall come down lower and lower."

questions.question: They will be left few in number, whereas they were as the stars, why?
options: Because you did not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because you did not obey the voice of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 28:62 (ESV): "...whereas you were as numerous as the stars of heaven, because you did not obey the voice of the Lord..."

key_verse_text: And if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God, being careful to do all his commandments that I command you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth. (ESV)
